Name: AT x CP - Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star Retexture
Author: MolaMole
Description:
I come back with a revision of my old [b]Tree of the Winter Star retexture[/b]!,
(somebody asked & Mole respond ∠( ᐛ 」∠)_ although pretty late), with different styles, swatches and decoration options. It include furniture and -for the [CP] ver.- the chance to customize the town & festival tree. There is a Animated ver. too  but with limitations.

There are...:
[list]
[*][b][b][CP] Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star -[/b][/b] Retexture the the Vanilla Tree and decal with the Plaza&Festival Tree[/*]
[*][b][b][AT] Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star - ﻿[/b][/b]Alternative Textures[/*]
[*][b][b][AT] Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star Animated ﻿[/b][/b][b][b]/[/b][/b] Alternative Textures but with working lights![/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3][Installation][/size]
[/b]* You have to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿ Installed first, Is a must!
* remember to read each required mod description page! (Mole only do a brief summary)

[quote][center][b]﻿﻿[AT]﻿[/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*][b]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative texture[/url]﻿ - the texture is selected by the [b]bucket tool[/b]![/b][/*]
[*]Download the Molamole's [b][AT] ver.[/b][/*]
[*]Move them in the "Mods" file created by Smapi[/*]
[/list][/quote][quote][center][b]﻿﻿[CP]﻿[/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Do﻿wnload [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿- the furniture is customized by [b]GMCM[/b] [b]panel[/b]![/*]
[*]Download the [b][CP] ver. Mod.[/b][/*]
[*]Move them in the "Mods" file created by Smapi.﻿﻿[/*]
[/list][/quote][b][s][size=3]
[ Known issues][/size][/s][/b]
None - for now - (If you find one pls let me know!)

[center][i][i]---------------- [ESP] ----------------[/i][/i][/center]

He regresado con una revisión de mi versión de arbolito de no navidad
( alguien pregunta y la topa responde ∠( ᐛ 」∠)＿ aun que con mucha demora, imaginen un topo en un teclado de tamaño normal, ir de izquierda a derecha puede tomar semanas) Con 3 estilos, diferentes colores y opciones de decoración, murales y plantas decorativas, además de la posibilidad de editar el árbol de no navidad de la plaza!

En resumen...:
[list]
[*][b][b][CP] Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star -[/b][/b] retextura el árbol original y la decoración además del árbol de la plaza y festival[/*]

[*][b][b][AT] Molamole's Tree Of The Winter Star Animated ﻿[/b][/b][b][b]/[/b][/b] Alternative Textures pero con luces funcionales![/*]
[/list]

[/b]* Antes que nada debes tener [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿ Instalado, no es opcional!
